name: protein tyrosine phosphatase receptor type D

function.text: PTPRD encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase delta. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine phosphatase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in signal transduction and neuron differentiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Invasive Breast Carcinoma; Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
